arxiv-2106-11260.title: The q T q_{\mathrm{T}} and Δ ​ ϕ \Delta\phi spectra in W W and Z Z production at the LHC at N 3 LL ′ +N 2 LO
arxiv-2106-11260.creator: Wan-Li Ju, Marek Schönherr
arxiv-2106-11260.description: Abstract The production of weak gauge bosons, W ± W^{\pm} and Z Z , are at the core of the LHC precision measurement program. Their transverse momentum spectra as well as their pairwise ratios are key theoretical inputs to many high-precision analyses, ranging from the W W mass measurement to the determination of parton distribution functions.

arxiv-2202-08629.title: A rapidly fading star as a type II obscuring intermediate luminosity optical transient (ILOT) in a triple star system
arxiv-2202-08629.creator: Ealeal Bear, Noam Soker, Amit Kashi
arxiv-2202-08629.description: Abstract We propose a triple-star scenario where the merger of two pre-main sequence low mass stars, ≲ 0.5 ​ M ⊙ {\lesssim 0.5M_{\odot}} , ejects a dusty equatorial outflow that obscures and temporarily causes the disappearance of a massive star, ≳ 8 ​ M ⊙ {\gtrsim 8M_{\odot}} . The merger of the low-mass inner binary powers a faint outburst, i.e.

arxiv-2206-05198.title: Stochastic formulation of incompressible fluid flows in wall-bounded regions
arxiv-2206-05198.creator: By Zhongmin Qian
arxiv-2206-05198.description: Abstract In this paper we establish a mathematical framework which may be used to design Monte-Carlo simulations for a class of time irreversible dynamic systems, such as incompressible fluid flows, including turbulent flows in wall-bounded regions, and some other (non-linear) dynamic systems.

arxiv-2208-04371.title: Characterization of Transmission Lines in Microelectronics Circuits using the ARTEMIS Solver
arxiv-2208-04371.creator: Saurabh S. Sawant, Zhi Yao, Revathi Jambunathan, Andrew Nonaka
arxiv-2208-04371.description: Abstract Modeling and characterization of electromagnetic wave interactions with microelectronic devices to derive network parameters has been a widely used practice in the electronic industry. However, as these devices become increasingly miniaturized with finer-scale geometric features, computational tools must make use of manycore/GPU architectures to efficiently resolve length and time scales of interest.

arxiv-2303-13834.title: Large deviation principles and Malliavin derivative for mean reflected stochastic differential equations
arxiv-2303-13834.creator: Ping Chen, Jianliang Zhai
arxiv-2303-13834.description: Abstract \theoremstyle definition \theoremstyle remark \theorembodyfont Abstract: In this paper, we consider a class of reflected stochastic differential equations for which the constraint is not on the paths of the solution but on its law. We establish a small noise large deviation principle, a large deviation for short time and the Malliavin derivative.

arxiv-2406-06805.title: Lookback Prophet Inequalities
arxiv-2406-06805.creator: Ziyad Benomar, Dorian Baudry, Vianney Perchet
arxiv-2406-06805.description: Abstract Prophet inequalities are fundamental optimal stopping problems, where a decision-maker observes sequentially items with values sampled independently from known distributions, and must decide at each new observation to either stop and gain the current value or reject it irrevocably and move to the next step.

pmc-11344290.title: Prevalence of urinary incontinence and associated factors, its impact on quality of life among pregnant women attending antenatal care at Asella teaching and referral hospital
pmc-11344290.creator: Melese Gezahegn Tesemma, Demisew Amenu Sori, Kifle Woldemichael Hajito
pmc-11344290.description: BackgroundUrinary incontinence (UI) is defined as any involuntary leakage of urine. UI during pregnancy is a common health problem worldwide with prevalence ranging from 11.4 to 84.5%. In Ethiopia there has been limited research conducted on UI among pregnant women.

pmc-11360032.title: Revisiting Aspirin Polymorphic Stability Using a Machine Learning Potential
pmc-11360032.creator: Shinnosuke Hattori, Qiang Zhu
pmc-11360032.description: In this study, we present a systematic computational investigation to analyze the long-debated free energy stability of two well-known aspirin polymorphs, denoted as Form I and Form II. Specifically, we developed a strategy to collect training configurations covering diverse interatomic interactions between representative functional groups in aspirin crystals.

pmc-11590363.title: Determinants of adequate antenatal care visits among pregnant women in low-resource setting: evidence from Tanzania national survey
pmc-11590363.creator: Elihuruma Eliufoo, Victoria Majengo, Yusheng Tian, Deogratius Bintabara, Fabiola Moshi, Yamin Li
pmc-11590363.description: BackgroundAntenatal care (ANC) plays a crucial role in reducing maternal fatalities and morbidities through early detection and management of pregnancy-related complications and ensures the proper referral in the level of care. Various variables facilitate a pregnant woman’s ability to schedule enough ANC visits. This research sought to identify factors contributing to Tanzanian pregnant women receiving adequate antenatal care.

pmc-11682538.title: Jigsaw as a Revision Module for Enhancing Learning in Biochemistry Among First-Year Medical Students
pmc-11682538.creator: Archana Nimesh, Rajani Kumawat, Saket Sinha, Harshitha Ramoju, Gitanjali Goyal, Akhilesh Pathak, Himanshu Sharma
pmc-11682538.description: AimBiochemistry includes the elaborate study of various biomolecules and intricate mechanisms that first-year medical students find difficult to understand and retain when taught through didactic lectures. Therefore, this study aims to test the effectiveness of jigsaw as a revision module in increasing the knowledge and retention capacity of students in Biochemistry.Materials and methodsEighty students were enrolled in the study.

pmc-13021407.title: Mitochondrial respiration in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells: methodology and influence of permeabilization and storage
pmc-13021407.creator: Shusuke Sekine, Imen Chamkha, Evelina Elmér, Eleonor Åsander Frostner, Emil Westerlund, Tianshi Liu, Johannes Ehinger, Fredrik Sjövall, Hiroyuki Uchino, Eskil Elmér
pmc-13021407.description: Human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) can be easily sampled from healthy individuals and patients. Density gradient isolation from human blood or leukocyte concentrates yields a mononuclear cell population of mainly lymphocytes, monocytes, and natural killer (NK) cells. PBMCs are vital circulating cells of the immune system and rely on oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) for their energy production.

pmc-13058964.title: Bidirectional longitudinal relationships between MRI-detected structural changes and contralateral knee pain in knee osteoarthritis: Data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative
pmc-13058964.creator: Shao-Hsien Liu, Jonggyu Baek, Kate L. Lapane, Julieann C. Patarini, Ming Zhang, Matthew S. Harkey, Grace H. Lo, Charles B. Eaton, Jamie MacKay, Timothy E. McAlindon, Jeffrey B. Driban
pmc-13058964.description: ObjectiveTo examine bidirectional longitudinal associations between MRI-detected structural changes and pain between knees (within a person) with or at risk for osteoarthritis (OA).DesignUsing data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) with a bidirectional knee-based design, each participant contributed two observations by alternating one knee as the exposure knee and the other as the contralateral (outcome) knee.

pmc-13096508.title: Effects of ultrasound-guided posterior quadratus lumborum block on atelectasis in pediatric patients undergoing inguinal hernia repair and orchiopexy surgeries: A randomized controlled study
pmc-13096508.creator: Çağdaş Baytar, Duygu Tatlı Uçarcı, Merve Sena Baytar, Keziban Bollucuoğlu, Hilal Ayoğlu
pmc-13096508.description: Insufficient lung expansion due to inadequate pain management and opioid consumption is one of the most important factor for perioperative atelectasis and and the use of ultrasound in the diagnosis of atelectasis has been quite common in recent years. The effectiveness of posterior quadratus lumborum block (QLB) in postoperative analgesia after open surgery is well established.

pmc-13194541.title: Molecular basis of precision nutrition: Food components, microbiome-derived metabolites, and multi-omics modeling
pmc-13194541.creator: Souvia Rahimah, Trina Ekawati Tallei, Maghfirah Savitri, Chika Yamada, Hyo Jung Kim, Min Choi, Moon Nyeo Park, Youdiil Ophinni, Bonglee Kim
pmc-13194541.description: Metabolic disorders, including obesity, type 2 diabetes, metabolic syndrome, and fatty liver disease, reflect multifactorial interactions among diet, host genetics, the environment, and the gut microbiome. However, conventional population-level dietary guidance often fails to capture the marked interindividual variability in metabolic responses to identical foods and nutrients.

pmc-13357124.title: Non-gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as cervical lymphadenopathy in a male patient: a case report
pmc-13357124.creator: Xiaoming Li, Daiying Gui, Chen Xie, Yunhong Xia
pmc-13357124.description: Non-gestational choriocarcinoma (NGCC) is a rare and highly aggressive malignancy in male patients and is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage because of its atypical clinical manifestations. We report the case of a 38-year-old male patient who presented a unilateral cervical tumor without associated genitourinary symptoms. Histopathological examination combined with immunohistochemical analysis subsequently confirmed the diagnosis of NGCC.

pmc-13504827.title: Polyphenols regulate bone health through the gut-bone axis: molecular and applications in animal nutrition
pmc-13504827.creator: Bo Gu, Jiaqi Wang, Xiaxin Liu, Jiantao Zhang, Tianwen Ma, Baoming Shi
pmc-13504827.description: This review summarizes the regulatory roles of polyphenolic compounds in animal skeletal health through the gut-bone axis and explores their benefits for animal nutrition. First, this review focuses on their key roles in maintaining skeletal homeostasis through gut microbiota, intestinal barrier integrity, immune regulation, microbial metabolites, and endocrine signaling.
